name: auth-failure
description: A token both header forms reject. The script tries the Bearer spelling, retries the same request once with the raw token, and when that is also refused it must end with a printed diagnostic and zero assets rather than aborting or spinning: exactly two requests, the fallback log line, and the final error line carrying the 401.

log_contains: stairwell: Bearer authorization rejected (401), retrying with the raw token form
